attributes.title: NASW NH 2027 Annual Conference
attributes.organizer: National Association of Social Workers, New Hampshire Chapter
attributes.summary:
The New Hampshire Chapter of NASW holds its eighth annual conference at the Omni Mount Washington Resort in Bretton Woods, with a pre-conference workshop on Sunday, May 23, 2027, and the main conference on May 24 and 25. The chapter pitches it as a destination conference in New Hampshire for social workers and allied professionals.

The 2027 brochure, with the session list and CE hours, is due in December. The agenda currently posted on the chapter page offers 6 CEs on each main conference day, plus a 3-CE stand-alone pre-conference workshop on suicide prevention (the Connect Program). Confirm the 2027 hours once the brochure is out.

Early-bird registration is open until December 1, 2026; member rates require NASW membership both when you register and at the time of the conference. The resort's group room rate closes about a month before the conference, and the chapter warns that the hotel fills up.
